title: Hold a transmission operator's licence
what: Operate a transacted transmission system (the State's transmission network, transferred under the Electricity Network Assets (Authorised Transactions) Act 2015) only under a transmission operator's licence.

sources.title: Electricity Supply Act 1995 (NSW)
